name: @usdk/capability-a11y
description: The capability-a11y interface contract (PDF Hypothesis III, page 4, 'Accessibility Features'). Unlike the other four capabilities, accessibility is ALWAYS available at the interface level and must not depend on successful microphone/vision/robotics/model loading - @usdk/uagent wires a conforming implementation directly, not through @usdk/loader's optional-capability path, precisely so a loader/driver failure elsewhere can never take accessibility down with it.
